definitions.explanation: A proposal or discussion regarding a potential marriage, especially one arranged through intermediaries or family connections. Refers to the proposal itself or the prospective match.

examples.japanese: {縁談|えんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}まれた→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧。
examples.english: A marriage proposal was brought to us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{縁談|えんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I heard from a relative that there's a good marriage prospect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{縁談|えんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|ことわ}って→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}い{張|は}っている→言い張る：29079_iiharu⟧。
examples.english: My daughter has turned down numerous marriage proposals and insists on finding a partner on her own.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally, marriages in Japan were often arranged through intermediaries (⟦{仲人|なこうど}→仲人：16691_nakoudo⟧), and {縁談|えんだん} was the proposal or match brought by such go-betweens. While arranged marriages have become less common in modern Japan, the word is still used and understood, appearing in period dramas, novels, and when families still facilitate introductions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縁談|えんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}まれる→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧: a marriage proposal is brought
- {縁談|えんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧: to turn down a marriage proposal
- {縁談|えんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まとまる→まとまる：01642_matomaru⟧: a marriage arrangement is settled
- {縁談|えんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to advance a marriage proposal
- ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{縁談|えんだん}: a good match
